How stUSDS works

What your capital does

The stUSDS module supplies the liquidity that backs SKY-collateralized borrowing within Sky Protocol. Your rate varies with how much of that liquidity is in use. 

Dynamic utilization-based rates

When your capital is not being borrowed, it accrues the Sky Savings Rate instead of the stUSDS rate.

stUSDS features set

Expert-level risk & reward

stUSDS is for people who understand lending markets. Your capital carries SKY price risk, and the rate reflects it.

Dynamic borrowing capacity

Borrowing capacity for SKY stakers grows when USDS is supplied and contracts when it leaves. A mechanism designed to ensure the system remains structurally sound.

Isolated risk infrastructure

stUSDS is kept separate from sUSDS. The module is designed to contain the risks associated with SKY-backed lending, protecting the broader protocol's stability.

Composable via Morpho Markets

stUSDS also works as collateral. It can be used to borrow USDS, USDC or USDT on the corresponding Morpho Markets.

Frequently asked questions about stUSDS

What is stUSDS?

stUSDS is what you receive when you supply USDS to the stUSDS module, which backs SKY-collateralized borrowing within Sky Protocol. The rate varies with utilization and has historically differed from the Sky Savings Rate.

How does it differ from sUSDS?

Unlike sUSDS, which is designed for stability, stUSDS involves specific risk of SKY price volatility. This requires an understanding of lending markets, utilization rates, and the volatility of the underlying collateral (SKY).

How does the "Smart Burn Engine" affect me?

The Smart Burn Engine uses Sky protocol surplus to buy SKY on the open market. It is a protocol mechanism and Sky.money does not control it. It does not determine the stUSDS rate, which is set by module utilization.

Can I use stUSDS in other DeFi apps?

Absolutely. stUSDS is a composable ERC-4626 token. You can use it as collateral in Vaults accessible through Sky.money and which run on Morpho to access further liquidity or more advanced yield strategies, while your position continues to accrue at the prevailing stUSDS rate.

How is the stUSDS yield generated?

The yield is dynamic and depends on how your capital is being used. When SKY stakers borrow your supplied USDS, you accrue from the SKY Borrow Rate (paid by borrowers to the Sky Protocol). When your capital is not being borrowed, it automatically accrues the Sky Savings Rate (SSR).

What are the risks of holding stUSDS?

The primary risks include SKY price volatility and potential bad debt if liquidations do not cover borrowed amounts. Because the pool is often highly utilized (targeted at 90%), there may be temporary withdrawal constraints during periods of extreme demand.

‍

Does stUSDS risk influence other Sky.money products?

From a risk perspective, stUSDS is structurally isolated so that any risks associated with SKY-backed lending are contained within the stUSDS pool. USDS and sUSDS holders are completely separate. stUSDS risk can affect the Risk Capital Vaults on Morpho.

How do I withdraw my USDS?

You can initiate a withdrawal through the Sky.money interface at any time. Your stUSDS will be converted back to USDS plus what it has accrued at the stUSDS rate. Withdrawals depend on unutilized liquidity in the pool.
